truth.intro: You've probably seen this before: a low headline price, then insurance, an excess deposit, a delivery fee, fuel — one on top of another, until you reach a number you never budgeted for. We do the opposite: we tell you the final price upfront.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before renting with us. Can't find it here? Call us at 22420 12345.

items.q: What do I need to bring when I pick up the car?
items.a: Your driver's license (held for at least 1 year), a passport or ID card, and the credit or debit card used to book — all under the same name as the reservation.

items.q: What's the minimum age to rent?
items.a: 21, with at least 1 year of driving experience. Drivers under 25 may have a small young-driver surcharge depending on the car category — we'll tell you upfront, never at the counter.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: Anytime — even the same day if a car's available. Booking a few days ahead just guarantees your preferred category, especially in July–August.

items.q: Is the price I see really the price I pay?
items.a: Yes. The rate shown includes full insurance, unlimited mileage, and airport delivery — no surprise extras at pickup. That's the whole point of "35€ means 35€."
We place a refundable hold on your card at pickup (released automatically once the car's returned undamaged) — it's held, not charged.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Visa and Mastercard, credit or debit. We can't take cash for the deposit hold, but cash works fine for the rental itself if you prefer.

items.q: Where can I pick up the car?
items.a: Free delivery to Kos Airport, or pick up from our city office — your choice at booking, no extra charge either way.
Full-to-full — you get the car with a full tank and return it full. No refueling markup.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my booking?
items.a: Yes, free of charge up to 24 hours before pickup. Just call or email us and we'll sort it out.
